newsitem.title: UK: Phillips UK force majeures oil loadings - trade.
newsitem.headline: Phillips UK force majeures oil loadings - trade.

text.p: Phillips Petroleum declared "force majeure" on oil product liftings at its 100,000 barrels per day Tees refinery in the U.K. on Wednesday evening, a trader who had seen the telex said.

Traders close to the refinery confirmed that the plant had been closed for a couple of days this week due to technical problems arising from the start up of a new unit, but claimed the refinery was working again on Thursday.
Traders did not know how many cargoes had been affected by the "force majeure" and Phillips officials declined to comment.
